deviations_from_card: Commit order: core feature first, then VisibleEditsTest, because the tests cannot compile before ClearFrame/undoAt/asTransport exist. Red-before was measured in the working tree against compiling stubs that keep today's behaviour (ClearFrame = Clear, undoAt/redoAt = null, asTransport = null, plan ignores undoAtMs, HeartbeatInput fields not copied): 6 of 8 red, cases 3 and 6 (GUARDs) green. PenEngine.undoAt/redoAt count a target as on screen from ON_MOMENT_LEAD_MS (40 ms) before its anchor, the lead review mode's jump already allows, so a seek that lands one frame early does not make every press loop into another trip. For a RemoveSet (a cleared frame) the trip goes to the latest anchor of the set, the one frame where every cleared annotation is visible. Session gains edit(msg) for the plan's Edit actions, so a planned Undo does not loop back into the planner. The companion label is 'Undo · 5.0s' (the page's own separator) rather than 'Undo - 5.0s'. tools/relay-stub.mjs is unchanged: /health already spreads the last state unread, so undoAtMs/redoAtMs appear there with no edit. The TV's LAN /health (HealthBody.kt, outside the write set) does not carry the new fields; live-ui-test 9b reads them from the phone's state instead. README core test count updated 61 -> 79. No desk/ or tools/*.cjs touched, so no desk gate.
notes: Wire (additive): PenMessage {type:'clearFrame'}; TvMessage.State.undoAtMs/redoAtMs (Long?, omitted when null via explicitNulls=false). {type:'clear'} unchanged: whole clip, remote Down and the harness clean slate. New core API: Op.RemoveSet(removed: List<IndexedValue<Annotation>>), History.peekUndo()/peekRedo(), PenEngine.undoAt(tMs)/redoAt(tMs), fun PenMessage.asTransport(): Transport?, TransportPlan.plan(..., undoAtMs: Long? = null, redoAtMs: Long? = null), HeartbeatInput.undoAtMs/redoAtMs. tv-app: Session.accept routes Undo/Redo to the transport flow; Session.edit applies directly; Session.undoAt/redoAt. Phone undo now waits one Compose recomposition (the transport StateFlow) instead of hitting the engine on the socket thread; two presses inside one frame could conflate, the same as any transport command today. No device available: live-ui-test section 9b (off-screen undo trip) was written but not run, and the TV side of the flow is proven by JVM tests only. Companion verified headless with a fake TV (scratch script, not committed): labels 'Undo · 5.0s' / 'Redo · 38.2s', Clear -> clearFrame, Clear all -> clear, Undo -> undo, no page errors, four-button row fits at 412 px.
